entries.03a7e8944660bf3c: This service receives commissions from pharmaceutical companies and develops and operates PHR platforms for patients and healthcare professionals for each disease, in the areas of lifestyle-related diseases, cancer, and specified chronic diseases. The company receives platform construction fees (development costs) and usage fees from pharmaceutical companies. Use as an information-gathering tool (ePRO) for clinical research is also increasing. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥337 million.
entries.06aeb117a1df898f: This is a business that provides PHR (Personal Health Record) platform services that support patients in self-management in the treatment of various diseases, including lifestyle-related diseases such as diabetes and hypertension. The reportable segment consists solely of this business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥635 million. As of December 31, 2025, the number of consolidated employees was 44.

entries.323168539bb952db: Against a backdrop of a super-aging society, the rise in chronic diseases and shortages of medical resources, the business environment is one in which the need for patient self-management and remote monitoring using PHR is growing.
entries.36675e61f2ef28c9: The company provides disease-specific PHR platform development and operation commissioned by pharmaceutical companies (disease solutions services), and its proprietary cloud service “Welby Maikarute,” which supports patients’ self-management.
entries.3c9c58723a9faee9: Based on the statements in “Business Description” and “Management’s Analysis of Financial Position, Operating Results and Cash Flows” that total app downloads were approximately 1.23 million as of the end of December 2025, that users had registered 33,010 regular medical institutions, and that connection to My Number Portal made it possible to obtain and view vaccination records, medication information and specific health checkup information.
entries.3d5976751bb36331: It is a cloud service built and operated in-house by the company's group, supporting patients in the self-management of lifestyle-related diseases in general, such as diabetes and hypertension. Revenue is earned through OEM provision of the PHR platform and usage fees charged to health insurance associations, local governments, medical institutions, and medical-related companies such as pharmaceutical companies, device manufacturers and testing companies. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥298 million.
entries.3e8e7e7398263e3c: A company that provides a PHR platform, which records patients' health and medical information and shares it with medical institutions, to pharmaceutical companies, insurers and others.
entries.4619ee21cbe3f0c6: Under its business mission, “Empower the Patients,” it states that it will concentrate management resources on the PHR platform service business and the data portability platform service business. Its policy is to expand service menus in each disease area and promote proposal activities targeting disease areas it has not yet approached.
